attributes.description:
Overview

This feature service provides spatial records for parks in Sydney. It includes park boundaries or park locations along with core identifying attributes such as name, type, asset identifier, and playground information.

Feature Layer
  • Sydney_Parks: Contains park features for the Sydney area and supports viewing, querying, and mapping park assets and related characteristics.
Geographic Coverage

The data covers Sydney, Australia, at a municipal scale.

Use Cases
  • Mapping park distribution across Sydney
  • Supporting parks inventory and asset management workflows
  • Identifying parks that include playground amenities
  • Creating neighborhood and public open space analyses

attributes.description: After I graduate in May I will be moving to Sydney to live and start my career. I created this map to help me chose a location to begin searching for apartment buildings/places to live. This decision will be based upon the proximity to the jobs I am applying for and the ability to walk, bike, or ride a train to work as I will not be owning a car while I live in Sydney. Another aspect I love about the city of Sydney is its gorgeous outdoor areas and botanical gardens. In order to encompass all of my criteria for making this decision, this map displays potential job locations, community gardens, and the bike lanes and train stations/lines in Sydney.
